metadata.question: Was there a decrease in rainfall in Zimbabwe in February 2024 compared to February 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS Daily for rainfall ( gauge + satellite, 0.05°, global). - Date: 2023-02-01 → 2023-02-28 and 2024-02-01 → 2024-02-29 (leap year). - Location: Zimbabwe administrative boundary via the simplified FAO GAUL 0 feature collection (code âZWEâ). 2. Masking: No cloud masking needed; precipitation band is continuous. 3. Logic: sum daily precipitation per year → compare. - If either collection empty → C1. - If sum returns None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise: 2024 sum < 2023 sum → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time zim = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017").filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Zimbabwe')).geometry() feb23 = ee.DateRange('2023-02-01', '2023-02-28') feb24 = ee.DateRange('2024-02-01', '2024-02-29') # 2. Acquire collections col23 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY').filterBounds(zim).filterDate(feb23) col24 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY').filterBounds(zim).filterDate(feb24) if col23.size().getInfo() == 0 or col24.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1") print("C1") else: # 3. Sum rainfall sum23 = col23.sum().multiply(86400) # convert mm/day → total mm sum24 = col24.sum().multiply(86400) tot23 = sum23.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=zim, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() tot24 = sum24.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=zim, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() if tot23 is None or tot24 is None: print("C3") else: print(f"Feb2023: {tot23:.1f} mm, Feb2024: {tot24:.1f} mm") print("A" if tot24 < tot23 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
zim = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017").filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Zimbabwe')).geometry()
feb23 = ee.DateRange('2023-02-01', '2023-02-28')
feb24 = ee.DateRange('2024-02-01', '2024-02-29')

# 2. Acquire collections
col23 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY').filterBounds(zim).filterDate(feb23)
col24 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY').filterBounds(zim).filterDate(feb24)

if col23.size().getInfo() == 0 or col24.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("C1")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Sum rainfall
    sum23 = col23.sum().multiply(86400)  # convert mm/day → total mm
    sum24 = col24.sum().multiply(86400)
    tot23 = sum23.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=zim, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    tot24 = sum24.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=zim, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    if tot23 is None or tot24 is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Feb2023: {tot23:.1f} mm, Feb2024: {tot24:.1f} mm")
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if tot24 < tot23 else "<answer>B</answer>")
